test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Moksha’ is an item of which of the following classical dance forms of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Moksha"** symbolizes spiritual liberation in **Hindi Tradition**.
 
• A distinctive part of the Odissi tradition is the inclusion of Moksha (or Mokshya) finale in the performance sequence. 
 
• This the concluding item of a recital. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya**

 
 
• **Classical dance **form of **Assam**.
 
• Originated in **Vaishnavite monasteries **(Sattras).
 
• Rooted in devotional worship of **Lord Krishna and Radha**.
 
• Revived in the **20th century **and recognized as a **classical dance form in 2000**.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• Major classical dance form of India.
 
• Originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• Combines nritta, nritya, and natya elements.
 
• 
 
Experienced a revival in the 20th century.

 
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• **Classical dance **form of **North India**.
 
• Originated in **ancient temples**, **emphasizing storytelling**.
 
• Combines **rhythmic footwork, hand gestures, spins, and storytelling**.
 
• Known for various **gharanas **(schools) with **distinct styles**.
 
• Repertoire includes **themes **from **mythology, love, and history**.
 
• Emphasizes **technical precision **and **emotional expression**.
